title: PASSPORT WAHALA: LONDON TO NAIJA EXPRESS
caption: Passport forms. Family parcels. A queue that started in 1999. Bounce and Dash take on the full UK-Nigeria diaspora errand run — and somehow only BootHop keeps it from becoming a national emergency. 🧡🐭 #BounceOnTheMove
story: Bounce faces a full-scale diaspora emergency: a same-day Nigeria Immigration Service passport intervention appointment, a mountain of family parcels to collect including the infamous unspecified 'thing' from Mum, and documents printed on the wrong paper size. At the chaotic consular queue they meet Kolade, a magnificently unhurried slow loris queue marshal whose single wise remark about arriving prepared nudges Dash into full BootHop mode. Dash quietly uses BootHop to re-route their entire day — reprinting documents, booking post office slots and locating the exact soap brand Bounce's mum wanted — turning certain disaster into a smooth, triumphant departure.
